subject: FinPay: MAP & stakeholder map follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@finpay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: FinPay discovery — MAP & next steps (post-call recap)

Emma — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Call highlights:
- Use case: FinPay wants to reduce per-transaction NLP cost for dispute classification and to add a lightweight assistant for merchant support.
- Key decision criteria: latency under 200ms for short responses, predictable unit cost for high-volume inference, and SOC2/compliance posture.
- Economic buyer: you indicated CFO (Liam Carter) will sign off on financials.
- Security/legal: security team requires SOC2 report and a data retention policy; legal will review DPA.
- Procurement: there will be a standard PO process and a 30-45 day payment term typical for enterprise.

Proposed MAP (attached: FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx):
1) Technical eval & perf bake — 2 weeks (proof of concept: sample load test, latency benchmarks) — owner: Redwood/FinPay Eng
2) Security/compliance review — 1 week (SOC2 questionnaire + data retention docs) — owner: FinPay Security + Redwood Security
3) Commercials & legal — 1-2 weeks (term negotiation and PO) — owner: FinPay Procurement + Redwood Legal
4) Exec sign-off & rollout planning — target: 6 weeks from kickoff — owner: FinPay Execs + Redwood AE

Ask: can you confirm the economic buyer (Liam) and the procurement contact? If possible, please share the SOC2 contact and any templates (procurement/PO) so we can align the MAP with your timelines. I attached the initial MAP draft and the standard SOC2 questionnaire we typically send.

Availability: I can host a 30-min MAP review next Tue/Wed (Aug 25/26) — what works best?

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2_questionnaire.pdf

From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Carter <liam.carter@finpay.com>, Procurement <procurement@finpay.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinPay discovery — MAP & next steps (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — great recap. Confirming a few items: 
- Economic buyer: yes, Liam Carter (CFO) will sign off on the budget — looping him in.
- Procurement contact: procurement@finpay.com (cc'd) — they handle PO templates and payment terms.
- Security: our InfoSec lead is Mei Tan (meisecurity@finpay.com) — they will want the SOC2 report and data handling summary.

Quick note on timelines: Procurement typically needs a PO template and final pricing to trigger approvals (we can move faster if pricing is firm). Security will want an initial questionnaire answered before the POC.

MAP request: yes, please update the MAP to include explicit sign-off milestones and a handoff checklist for security evidence. If you can get an updated MAP by Monday, we can align internal stakeholders and aim for a kickoff the week of Aug 31.

I can do Tue Aug 25 at 10am PT for the 30-min review.

Best,
Emma
VP Product, FinPay

- explicit sign-off gates (technical, security, commercial, exec)

- owner for each milestone and suggested dates (target kickoff week of Aug 31)

- Rishi will prepare a pricing/discount outline for procurement.
- Vivek (legal) and Laura (CS) are looped to prep for the security evidence and rollout plan.

Forwarding procurement for PO template and any contractual constraints.

- Standard payment terms: Net 30 (we can discuss Net 45 with exec approval).
- We require insurance and indemnity clauses to match our legal team's baseline.
- If there are any standard SLA credits, list them in the commercial appendix.

Please send a final pricing sheet and your standard DPA for our legal review. Procurement will queue the request after we receive the PO and final commercial terms.

Thanks,
FinPay Procurement
